content:
Apple is now rolling out new beta software for developers, including beta 3 for iPadOS 27.2, tvOS 27.2, and more.

Beta 3 arrives for iPadOS 27.2 and more

New betas are available today for developer testing, arriving two full weeks after Apple’s last round.

Beta 3 is rolling out now for iPadOS 27.2, tvOS 27.2, visionOS 27.2, and more.

The highlights of the 27.2 betas so far include:

  • All-new Health app with Apple Intelligence
  • Apple TV profiles coming to iPhone and iPad
  • Siri AI adds Mac-inspired shortcut to iPad
  • More support languages for Siri AI

Today’s beta 3 updates might add to this list. We’ll keep you posted on any new features we discover.

It’s also very possible that additional features not yet revealed might be tied to forthcoming hardware announcements. Apple is rumored to launch new Home products, Macs, and more in the next few weeks.

No public betas are available yet for beta 3, but those will likely roll out in the next day or so.

Have you found anything new in iPadOS 27.2 beta 3 or another update? Let us know in the comments.
